subject: Segmentation & rollout plan for additional projects — next steps and capacity commit
messages:
From: Mitchell Carter <mitchell.carter@clearpath.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Expanding to three new project teams — high level ask

Markus,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our engineering leads reviewed the hosted API and want to move forward with three additional projects this quarter (ClinicalDocs, IntakeForms, and BillingAssist). High level asks:

- Separate API keys per project for governance and rate limiting
- ~2x current peak capacity across the account during business hours (US-East)
- Updated pricing for additional usage and a one-off setup for segmented keys

Can you share a rollout proposal and rough cost so we can align with procurement? Happy to jump on a quick call if helpful — Jamie (copied) will lead implementation from our side.

Thanks,
Mitchell
Sr. Platform PM | ClearPath Health

---
Attachments: none
From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: Mitchell Carter <mitchell.carter@clearpath.com>
Cc: Jamie Lin <jamie.lin@clearpath.com>
Date: 2027-04-30T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Expanding to three new project teams — high level ask

Mitchell / Jamie — great to hear. I put together a short plan below and attached a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and rough pricing workbook. Key points: 

- Segmented API keys: we recommend one key per project + one shared admin key for platform ops. Keys can be scoped by route and rate limits.
- Capacity: we can provision a staged capacity bump (pilot -> phase A -> full) to avoid a large upfront commit. For your 2x peak ask, recommended reserved buffer is +30% for bursts.
- Pricing: I attached a workbook with a blended committed rate plus overage tiers. Rough estimate for the three projects (month 1 steady-state) is ~$18k/mo in hosted usage, with one-time onboarding fee in the proposal.

Proposed next steps:
1) Alignment call (30 min) this week to lock scope and phasing
2) Sign MAP to capture milestones and responsibilities
3) DocuSign for the amendment and issuance of segmented keys

I copied our CS lead and AM to coordinate onboarding and security checklist.

Regards,
Markus Klein
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: ClearPath_MAP_v1.pdf, pricing-proposal-ClearPath.xlsx
From: markus_klein@redwood.ai

Date: 2027-05-01T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: ClearPath expansion — phasing and key segmentation (internal)

Team — forwarding the request from ClearPath (below). Need two things from you: 

Laura — confirm the capacity plan and whether we can offer the staged commit below without SLA degradation. Suggest:
- Pilot (2 weeks): existing capacity + 10% (no commit)
- Phase A (30 days): reserved commit at 1.5x current peak
- Phase B (90 days): full reserved at 2x peak + 30% buffer

Priyom — can you draft a segmented key issuance template and onboarding playbook steps? Include: key permissions, TTL & rotation recommendation, monitoring hooks, and an escalation contact list. Aim to have a ready playbook by EOD Friday.

I think we can be flexible on the one-time onboarding fee if procurement pushes back, but we'll keep the monthly commit intact.

Thanks — MK

Markus — quick update on capacity/ops:

- We can support the proposed three-stage approach. No SLA change required for the pilot.
- For Phase A, we recommend a soft commit (monthly reserved pool) and autoscale buffer; ops estimates ~6 GPU-hours/day additional during business hours.
- Phase B will require a formal capacity add (reserved instances) — procurement lead time ~14 business days once the amendment is signed.

I attached an updated onboarding playbook draft that maps the key steps and owners (security review, API scoping, key issuance, traffic cutover, monitoring). Priyom — please use this as a template and highlight any missing RBAC details.

Laura
